Thereby the star witness to the prosecution case completely turned hostile to the case.

13. They have also clarified that, they did not give any statement about her death before the IO.

The Learned Public Prosecutor has cross examined PW2 to 4 regarding their statements as per Ex.P-2 to P-4 respectively but they denied all the leading questions put to them and clarified that accused persons are not responsible for the death of deceased-Smt. Supriya Cholin 14.
PW5 the IO has deposed to the effect that he has worked as Police Inspector in JP Nagar PS from 22.02.2019 to 30.03.2021.

That on 06.05.2019 he was the Station House Officer i.e., SHO, of said PS, he received a written complaint from CW-1 about unnatural SC No.164/2020 death of his daughter Smt. Supriya Cholin accordingly he registered a case against the accused persons in Crime No.75/2019.
The witness identified the complaint at Ex.P-1, his signature at Ex.P-1(b).

Thereafter, on the same day he visited scene of crime, in presence of two panchas CW-10 and 11 and as per the place shown by CW-3 he drawn spot mahazar at Ex.P8 and his signature at Ex.P- 8(a).
Later on the same day he recorded the statements of CW-3 and 4 and appointed the constables to trace and apprehend the accused persons.

Accordingly on 06.05.2019 the PC No.12374 brought the accused No.1 and 2 and produced them before him in the PS after medical examination of accused No.1 and 2 he got them produced through the police before the learned Jurisdictional Magistrate.

He also identified the report submitted by his subordinate as per Ex.P-9 regarding arrest of accused No.1 and 2 and signature of PC.
The witness has identified the ligature material a saree at MO-1.
The IO has further deposed that, on 13.06.2019 since the accused No.3 and 4 were granted anticipatory bail as such as per said order he formally arrest them and released on bail.
On 15.06.2049 as the investigation SC No.164/2020 was completed as such he filed charge sheet against the accused No.1 to 4.
The witness has identified the accused No.1 before the court.
16. The contents of first information depicts that, on 15-05-2015 after registered marriage the accused No.1 and his wife Smt. Supriya Cholin resided together in matrimonial home as mentioned above.

They lived happy marital life for sometime but at the instigation of accused No.2 to 4 the accused No.1 has allegedly harassed his wife for dowry and said harassment were continuous and severe which led the wife to end her life on 05-05-2019 though she was fully aware of the fact

. But the accused No.1 has denied these allegations and pleaded innocence of any such charge.
The burden to prove the dowry harassment or continuous harassment was on the prosecution of course it has tried to discharge it by examining father and close relatives of the deceased.

17 . The only witness who supported the prosecution case is the investigating officer PW-5 but his evidence is all about the legal formalities from the time of SC No.164/2020 registration of case,
conducting investigation collection of evidence like MO-1, PM and inquest reports and recording of statements of witnesses and he has deposed in consonance with the investigation he has done.

But his evidence has nothing to do with the prosecution case so far the allegations of mental and physical harassment to the deceased for anything including the dowry harassment to Smt. Supriya Cholin.
In the absence of evidence of PW-1 to 4 solely on the basis of PW-5's evidence accused cannot be convicted.
18. Even though 9 documents are marked on behalf of the prosecution but their contents are not proved by the prosecution.
It is well settled law that, mere marking of document does not dispense with its proof.

Therefore, taking into considering the allegations leveled against the accused, the quality of evidence on record I am of the opinion that, the prosecution has failed to discharge its burden of proving the guilt of the accused No.1 for the alleged offences.
Thus I further hold that, the prosecution has miserably failed to prove the guilt of accused No.1 for the offences PUS 498A, 306 or Section 304B of IPC and U/S 4 of DP Act beyond reasonable doubt.

Accordingly, I answer the above points in Negative.
19. Point No.3:-In the result

I proceed to pass the following;
SC No.164/2020 ORDER Acting U/S 235(1) of Cr.P.C. the accused No.1 is hereby acquitted from the charges leveled against him for the offences punishable U/s.498A and 306 or 304-B r/w 34 of Indian Penal Code and section 4 of DP Act.
The Bail bonds and surety bond of the accused No.1 stand canceled.
MO1 being worthless ordered to destroy after appeal period is over.
